#requires -Version 5.1
# Safe-mode maintenance only: no live release promotion, real order calls or authorization changes.
[CmdletBinding()]
param([switch]$RepairAndStart)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$root='E:\SwiftAutoTraderCertification\read-only-pilot\installed'
$release='0c090e034ba7a761a1eb1a0cd08e06c91ddf8098'
$rxHome=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'SwiftReceiveOnly-20261114'
$paperHome=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'SwiftPaperPilot-20261114'
$rxName='SwiftAutoTrader-ReceiveOnly-Local';$paperName='SwiftAutoTrader-PaperPilot-Local'
$rxFile=Join-Path $rxHome 'Run-ReceiveOnly.ps1'
$paperFile=Join-Path $paperHome 'Run-PaperPilot.ps1'
$python=Join-Path $root "releases\$release\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$pinOld='0e31fd7ca4ef3073b72085f8aaac702aa39dee3df78f3d7dca2b8440bb7fb3b1';$pinNew='a5573bd259b58c63c1f3ed7836eeee9271cd9ce4b0832f1886b47caff0bb248c'
$patchBase64=''
$report=[ordered]@{status='BLOCKED';mode='RECEIVE_ONLY_AND_PAPER_ONLY';production_release_modified=$false;receiver_launcher_modified=$false;real_order_submission=$false;live_certified=$false;approval_settings_changed=$false;steps=[ordered]@{}}
$phase='observation';$failureCode='UNEXPECTED_LOCAL_ERROR';$backup=$null
function Require([bool]$Condition,[string]$Code){if(!$Condition){throw ('SWIFT_CHECK:'+$Code)}}
function SafePath([string]$Path){
    Require (Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path) 'REQUIRED_PATH_MISSING'
    $p=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath($Path)
    while($p){
        $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force
        Require (!(($item.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint))) 'REDIRECTED_PATH'
        $up=[IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($p)
        if(!$up -or $p -eq $up){break};$p=$up
    }
}
function Hash([string]$p){ SafePath $p; return (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }
function J([string]$p){SafePath $p;return (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)}
function CurrentTask([string]$Name){$t=@(Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $Name -ErrorAction Stop);Require ($t.Count -eq 1 -and $t[0].TaskPath -eq '\') 'TASK_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED';return $t[0]}
function TaskObservation([string]$Name){
    try{$t=CurrentTask $Name;$i=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $Name -TaskPath '\';return [ordered]@{state=[string]$t.State;last_result=$i.LastTaskResult;last_run=[string]$i.LastRunTime}}
    catch{return [ordered]@{state='UNAVAILABLE'}}
}
function CheckTask([string]$Name,[string]$Launcher){
    $t=CurrentTask $Name;$a=@($t.Actions);$expected='-NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+$Launcher+'"'
    Require ($a.Count -eq 1 -and $a[0].Execute -ieq (Join-Path $PSHOME 'powershell.exe') -and $a[0].Arguments -ieq $expected) 'TASK_ACTION_DIFFERS_FROM_VERIFIED_INSTALL'
    $owner=[System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()
    $uid=[string]$t.Principal.UserId
    if($uid -match '^S-1-'){$sid=$uid}else{$sid=([System.Security.Principal.NTAccount]::new($uid)).Translate([System.Security.Principal.SecurityIdentifier]).Value}
    Require ($sid -eq $owner.User.Value -and [string]$t.Principal.LogonType -in @('Interactive','InteractiveToken')) 'TASK_PRINCIPAL_DIFFERS'
    Require ([string]$t.Settings.MultipleInstances -eq 'IgnoreNew') 'TASK_DUPLICATE_POLICY_DIFFERS'
    Require ([string]$t.State -ne 'Disabled') 'TASK_DISABLED_OPERATOR_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
}
function NoOtherTasks {
    $others=@(Get-ScheduledTask | Where-Object {$_.TaskName -match 'SwiftAutoTrader|Swift.*Companion' -and $_.State -ne 'Disabled' -and ($_.TaskPath -ne '\' -or $_.TaskName -notin @($rxName,$paperName))})
    Require ($others.Count -eq 0) 'OTHER_SWIFT_TASK_ENABLED'
}
function StopMarkers {
    $control=@((Join-Path $rxHome 'monitor.disabled'),(Join-Path $paperHome 'state\PAPER-STOP'),(Join-Path $root 'state\SWIFT_REVIEWED_STOP'),(Join-Path $root 'state\stop.request'),(Join-Path $root 'state\control\EMERGENCY_STOP.json'))
    foreach($p in $control){Require (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) 'STOP_MARKER_PRESENT_NOT_CLEARED'}
}
function AssertIdle {
    Require ((CurrentTask $rxName).State -eq 'Ready' -and (CurrentTask $paperName).State -eq 'Ready') 'TASKS_NOT_BOTH_IDLE_NO_TERMINATION_PERFORMED'
    # Detect existing Swift Python/PowerShell workers. No raw command lines leave this machine.
    $workers=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -and $_.Name -match '^(pythonw?|powershell|pwsh|py)\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)swift_autotrader|swift_reviewed|swift_portfolio_companion|Swift-Field-Check\.py|SwiftPaperPilot-20261114|SwiftReceiveOnly-20261114'})
    Require ($workers.Count -eq 0) 'OTHER_OR_RESIDUAL_SWIFT_PROCESS_PRESENT'
}
function RxHealth([DateTimeOffset]$Since){
    try{
        $h=J (Join-Path $root 'state\health.json');$t=[DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$h.as_of_utc);$age=([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow-$t).TotalSeconds
        if($t -lt $Since -or $age -lt 0 -or $age -gt 45 -or $h.status -ne 'RUNNING' -or $h.mode -ne 'PAPER_ONLY' -or $h.live_enabled -isnot [bool] -or $h.live_enabled -or $h.broker_writes_enabled -isnot [bool] -or $h.broker_writes_enabled -or $h.paper_dispatch_worker_enabled -isnot [bool] -or $h.paper_dispatch_worker_enabled -or $h.workers.telegram -isnot [bool] -or !$h.workers.telegram){return $false}
        if((CurrentTask $rxName).State -ne 'Running'){return $false}
        $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+[int]$h.pid) -ErrorAction Stop
        return [bool]($p -and $p.CommandLine -match '(?i)-m\s+swift_autotrader\.windows_runtime\s+service\b' -and $p.CommandLine -like ('*'+$root+'*'))
    }catch{return $false}
}
function PaperHealth([DateTimeOffset]$Since){
    try{
        $h=J (Join-Path $paperHome 'state\PAPER-STATUS.json');$t=[DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$h.as_of_utc);$age=([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow-$t).TotalSeconds
        if($t -lt $Since -or $age -lt 0 -or $age -gt 45 -or $h.status -ne 'PAPER_PILOT_RUNNING' -or $h.mode -ne 'PAPER_ONLY' -or $h.real_order_tools_called -isnot [bool] -or $h.real_order_tools_called -or $h.live_certified -isnot [bool] -or $h.live_certified -or $h.source_read_only -isnot [bool] -or !$h.source_read_only -or $h.broker_connected -isnot [bool] -or !$h.broker_connected){return $false}
        if((CurrentTask $paperName).State -ne 'Running'){return $false}
        $worker=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -match '^python(w)?\.exe$' -and $_.CommandLine -like ('*'+(Join-Path $paperHome 'pilot.py')+'*') -and $_.CommandLine -match '(?i)\s--run(?:\s|$)'})
        return ($worker.Count -ge 1)
    }catch{return $false}
}
function WaitHealthy([string]$Role,[DateTimeOffset]$Since,[int]$Seconds){
    $deadline=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds($Seconds)
    while([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow -lt $deadline){
        if($Role -eq 'receiver'){if(RxHealth $Since){return $true}}
        else {if(PaperHealth $Since){return $true}}
        Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
    }
    return $false
}
try{
    $report.steps.receiver_before=TaskObservation $rxName;$report.steps.paper_before=TaskObservation $paperName
    $phase='existing_release'; SafePath $root;SafePath $python
    Require ((Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'active-release.txt') -Raw).Trim() -eq $release) 'ACTIVE_RELEASE_DIFFERS'
    $m=J (Join-Path $root 'deployment.json')
    Require ($m.product -eq 'swift-options-autotrader' -and $m.mode -eq 'PAPER_ONLY' -and $m.live_enabled -is [bool] -and !$m.live_enabled -and $m.broker_writes_enabled -is [bool] -and !$m.broker_writes_enabled) 'DEPLOYMENT_NOT_PAPER_ONLY'
    $phase='task_identity';CheckTask $rxName $rxFile;CheckTask $paperName $paperFile;NoOtherTasks;StopMarkers
    $phase='receiver_files';$rxHash=Hash $rxFile
    Require ($rxHash -in @($pinOld,$pinNew)) 'RECEIVER_SOURCE_NOT_KNOWN_BASELINE'
    foreach($entry in @('verify.py|7b74c880c2932e875e11524744750c54980b36c05d307b5e94ffa7ed1048bef5','EXPECTED_RUNTIME_SHA256.json|9ee1567ab7588fe82f223620e5b58b6bacbf50905ecd71b5a67249647f8ced0f','EXPECTED_STAGED_CANDIDATE.json|5d73fb7dd7f389e45b42e4eaa54bbfd69b50c3efa49ee4088c24b48acaec82e1')){
        $name,$digest=$entry.Split('|');Require ((Hash (Join-Path $rxHome $name)) -eq $digest) 'RECEIVER_SUPPORT_FILE_MISMATCH'
    }
    $report.steps.receiver_launcher=if($rxHash -eq $pinOld){'ORIGINAL_CONFLICT_RULE_CONFIRMED'}else{'PATCH_ALREADY_PRESENT'}
    $phase='paper_files'
    Require ((Hash (Join-Path $paperHome 'PACKAGE_SHA256.json')) -eq '2cb07bd0431796e79835512f9c2bc701cb070281a4fb485384f5b2a21110557b') 'PAPER_MANIFEST_MISMATCH'
    Require ((Hash (Join-Path $paperHome 'verify_package.py')) -eq '0bd01815d66503c93fe0d2818ca0b8319bf52773a49d0dd6fbf5d646606b75c3') 'PAPER_VERIFIER_MISMATCH'
    SafePath $paperFile
    $raw=& $python -I -B (Join-Path $paperHome 'verify_package.py')
    $rc=$LASTEXITCODE;Require ($rc -eq 0) 'PAPER_PACKAGE_VERIFICATION_FAILED'
    $v=$raw | ConvertFrom-Json;Require ($v.status -eq 'PACKAGE_VERIFIED' -and $v.files -eq 66) 'PAPER_PACKAGE_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH'
    $report.steps.paper_source_files=$v.files
    $phase='local_runtime_verification';$raw=& $python -I -B (Join-Path $rxHome 'verify.py') --runtime-only
    $rc=$LASTEXITCODE;Require ($rc -eq 0) 'RUNTIME_OR_STOPPED_COMPANION_VERIFICATION_FAILED'
    $v=$raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    Require ($v.runtime_files_verified -eq 55 -and $v.reviewed_stopped -eq $true) 'RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH'
    $report.steps.runtime_files_verified=$v.runtime_files_verified;$report.steps.service_lock=$v.lock
    $report.steps.receiver_health_observed=RxHealth ([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(-45));$report.steps.paper_health_observed=PaperHealth ([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(-45))
    if(!$RepairAndStart){$report.status='DIAGNOSIS_COMPLETE_NO_CHANGES';return}
    $phase='idle_and_stop_gate';Require ($v.lock -eq 'AVAILABLE_AT_CHECK') 'RECEIVER_LOCK_BUSY_OR_UNAVAILABLE';AssertIdle;StopMarkers
    $phase='patch_receiver_launcher'
    if($rxHash -eq $pinOld){
        $tmp=Join-Path $rxHome ('receiver-repair-'+[Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.tmp')
        $backup=Join-Path $rxHome ('receiver-pre-coexistence-'+[Guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.ps1.bak')
        try{
            [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($tmp,[Convert]::FromBase64String($patchBase64))
            Require ((Hash $tmp) -eq $pinNew) 'PATCH_HASH_MISMATCH'
            $tokens=$null;$parseErrors=$null
            $null=[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($tmp,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$parseErrors)
            Require ($parseErrors.Count -eq 0) 'PATCH_POWERSHELL_PARSE_FAILED'
            CheckTask $rxName $rxFile;CheckTask $paperName $paperFile;NoOtherTasks;StopMarkers;AssertIdle
            Require ((Hash $rxFile) -eq $pinOld) 'RECEIVER_SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_CHECK'
            [IO.File]::Replace($tmp,$rxFile,$backup)
            $report.receiver_launcher_modified=$true
            Require ((Hash $rxFile) -eq $pinNew -and (Hash $backup) -eq $pinOld) 'POST_REPLACEMENT_HASH_MISMATCH'
            $report.steps.receiver_backup=(Split-Path -Leaf $backup)
        }finally{if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $tmp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force}}
    }
    $report.steps.receiver_patch='CHECKSUM_VERIFIED_COEXISTENCE_FIX'
    $phase='start_receiver';NoOtherTasks;StopMarkers;AssertIdle
    $since=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $rxName -TaskPath '\'
    $report.steps.receiver_start_requested=$true
    if(!(WaitHealthy 'receiver' $since 60)){
        $errPath=Join-Path $rxHome 'STARTUP-ERROR.json'
        try{$e=J $errPath;$et=[DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$e.as_of_utc);if($et -ge $since -and $e.phase -in @('runtime_verification','installed_manifest','scheduled_task_coexistence','paper_task_identity','paper_package_integrity','receiver_environment','notification_credentials','receiver_worker')){$report.steps.receiver_startup_phase=$e.phase}}catch{}
        Require $false 'RECEIVER_HEARTBEAT_OR_PROCESS_NOT_VERIFIED'
    }
    $report.steps.receiver='FRESH_RECEIVE_ONLY_HEARTBEAT_AND_PROCESS_VERIFIED'
    $phase='start_paper';CheckTask $paperName $paperFile;NoOtherTasks;StopMarkers
    Require ((CurrentTask $paperName).State -eq 'Ready') 'PAPER_TASK_NOT_IDLE'
    Require (RxHealth $since) 'RECEIVER_HEALTH_LOST_BEFORE_PAPER_START'
    $paperSince=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow;Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $paperName -TaskPath '\'
    $report.steps.paper_start_requested=$true
    if(!(WaitHealthy 'paper' $paperSince 90)){
        try{$h=J (Join-Path $paperHome 'state\PAPER-STATUS.json');if([DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$h.as_of_utc) -ge $paperSince){$report.steps.paper_reported_status=[string]$h.status}}catch{}
        Require $false 'PAPER_HEARTBEAT_OR_PROCESS_NOT_VERIFIED'
    }
    Require (RxHealth $since) 'RECEIVER_HEALTH_LOST_AFTER_PAPER_START'
    $report.steps.paper='FRESH_PAPER_ONLY_HEARTBEAT_AND_PROCESS_VERIFIED'
    $report.status='SAFE_MODE_SERVICES_OBSERVED_RUNNING_NOT_LIVE_CERTIFIED'
}catch{
    $report.steps.blocked_phase=$phase
    $msg=$_.Exception.Message
    if($msg -match '^SWIFT_CHECK:([A-Z0-9_]+)$'){$report.steps.blocker=$Matches[1]}else{$report.steps.blocker='UNEXPECTED_LOCAL_ERROR';$report.steps.error_type=$_.Exception.GetType().Name}
}finally{
    $report.steps.receiver_after=TaskObservation $rxName;$report.steps.paper_after=TaskObservation $paperName
    $report | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
}
